description: DELETE /v2/vpcs/{vpc_id} answers 409 `Can not delete VPC with members` while a droplet, cluster or database is still in the VPC, including for a while after a member was destroyed (live response, alchemy DigitalOcean Vpc suite). The spec lists only 401/404/429/500. Type it as VpcHasMembers so a delete can wait for the members to leave. It answers 403 `Can not delete default VPCs` for a region's default VPC, which DigitalOcean makes of the first VPC in a region; type that as VpcIsDefault so it is not mistaken for a permission error.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The VPC still has members (409 `Can not delete VPC with members`).
The VPC is its region's default VPC, which cannot be deleted (403 `Can not delete default VPCs`).
